notes: 24 first-round concerns judged (presentation and novelty excluded). The match note and in_v1 flags say referees reviewed v1 and none of the round-1 additions (vortex maps, 25/78 K data, pristine samples, interlayer spacing, 4Hb slab DFT) are in the paper text, so fixed_in_v1 is false throughout. Review A (a lookalike checklist adapted from topological transport) raised only C2 and partly C33; its strongest content (extrinsic broadening, tip-induced switching) matches no referee concern. Review B raised C2, C6, C11, C15, C16, C33 and partly matched 11 more; it missed the whole 1T superconducting-gap block (C23-C26) except a partial on C27, plus pristine samples, NbSe2 filling and local doping contrast. B's 'essential mechanism' comment matches C20 (presentation) and its Fig. 3b fit request overlaps C33. B's filling-calibration point (2.1) overlaps C19 (presentation) and later L5. C4 for B was judged partly because B treats the 1H superconducting transition as a constraint on Kondo screening, not as a confound of the 0.3 to 4.2 K width data.
